## Summary

Random Gaussian projection (384d) consistently outperforms text embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384d) across all 4 models, confirming that the HS advantage does NOT depend on PCA's variance-preserving property. Even structure-agnostic dimensionality reduction preserves the discriminative signal in hidden states.
